terra.problem: The text does not say the temple is the only place Dibon knows to take its sorrow.
The text does not say there is no music playing.
The text does not say wailing is the only sound or that nobody has a song in them.
The text does not say that no corner of the town is quiet.
The text does not say there is no quiet spot in town.
The verse says the soldiers cry out and tremble, not that nobody in Moab is staying calm.
The text does not say staying put is impossible.
The explanation mostly repeats the verse and ends with a generic observation about sound traveling.
The passage does not say how long the trip from Sela to Zion is.
The plea mentions fugitives, but the text does not identify the people speaking as fugitives.
The plea also asks for counsel and a decision, so a safe place is not all it asks for.
The explanation repeats the answer without adding a distinctive observation or much of Papa Dorin's voice.
The joke does not make sense: an empty cookie box would not rattle because there is nothing in it.
Calling the speaker “he” assigns a gender when the passage does not identify the speaker.
Saying the sorrow has not gone away after all the ruin adds a timeline the passage does not give.
Saying the sorrow did not fade after the ruin adds a timeline the passage does not give.
“Going through the motions” suggests insincere prayer, which the text does not say.
The text says Moab's splendor will become an object of contempt; it does not say it was previously admired.
The passage does not say whether Moab's splendor gets passed to anyone.
